manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R} minus {R} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability and Runaway Steam-Kin trigger.
Resolve the Runaway Steam-Kin trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages.
Repeat.
